rows.d: Replaces the health bar frame (drawn on top) with an image from images/. It is scaled and centered on the normal health bar by itself. With an .xml next to it, it plays as an animation (prefix = animation prefix, fps = speed, default 24). Empty = back to the mod's frame or the normal one.
rows.note: Mods with the new folder structure can also put bg.png in content/images/healthbar/ to use it in every song.

rows.d: Replaces the colored part of the health bar with an image (any shape, white is best). It is tinted with the health bar colors, so setHealthBarColors still works. Scaled to the width of the normal bar and centered. Animated with an .xml like setHealthBarBG. Empty = back to the mod's bar or the normal one.
rows.note: JSON version: data/songs/<song>/healthbar.json (that song) or data/healthbar.json (whole mod) with bg, bar (paths inside images/), scale, offset, barScale ([x, y] or one number, only the colored bar), barOffset ([x, y], moves only the colored bar), iconScale, iconOffset, iconBop, bgAnimation, barAnimation. Old folder content/images/healthbar/ still works.

rows.d: Puts the health bar back to the last loaded style (song or mod healthbar.json, or the normal one).

Loads a health bar style from a JSON inside data/ (e.g. 'healthbars/sonic' = data/healthbars/sonic.json), same fields as healthbar.json. Returns false if the file is missing. Empty = back to the song/mod healthbar.json.

rows.note: color, colorburn, colordodge, exclusion, hue, luminosity, saturation and softlight are new (same as V-Slice). The same names work for the blend option of setGhostTrail and createParticles, and for objects in stage .json files.

rows.d: Starts a dialogue of this song: data/songs/<song>/<name>.json (e.g. "dialogue-mid"). The HUD is hidden and pause is off until it ends. resume = true: when it ends, the countdown starts (or the song ends, if it was the end dialogue). Returns false if the file is missing.
rows.note: Changed in 1.3. dialogue.json and dialogue-end.json start by themselves (start and end of the song, only once, not in charting mode). The old Psych dialogue files no longer work. Made with the Dialogue Editor.

rows.p: character, type = "simple" | "animated" | "aura" | "off", ?{doubleNote, color, alpha, duration, distance, grow, rate, blend}
rows.d: Ghost trail on a character (bf, dad, gf or char number 3, 4...). simple = still ghosts that fade, animated = ghosts slide where the note points (distance = how far, in px), aura = glow that's always on, idle too. doubleNote (simple/animated only) = ghosts only on 2+ notes. color: "hp" or "health" = health bar color, empty = normal colors (aura: health bar color). Same as the Ghost Trail event.

rows.p: enabled, ?{characterColor, characterColors, backgroundColor, strength, characterAlpha, backgroundAlpha, duration, ease, hud, details}
rows.d: Turns characters into silhouettes with a solid background. characterColor = one color for everyone (empty = health colors), characterColors = one per character ({dad = "red", bf = "blue", ["3"] = "yellow"}), backgroundColor (empty = black), characterAlpha / backgroundAlpha, hud = also colors icons and health bar, details = keeps faces and lines visible (darker on light colors, lighter on dark ones). Same as the Silhouette event.
Color flash behind the characters that fades out. With characterColor the characters flash too. Same as the BG Flash event.

Tints the strum arrows with a color. target = "all" (or empty), "player", "opponent", "char3" (strumline of character 3, 4...) or a lane number (0-3 opponent, 4-7 player, 8+ extra strumlines). strength goes from 0 (no tint) to 1 (full color). Returns true if it worked.
rows.note: Stops a tweenStrumTint running on the same arrows. A note pack can give the arrows a starting tint (Note Editor > Shader > Strumline Shader): that is what resetStrumTint goes back to. Errors (no arrows, wrong color) only show with luaDebugMode = true.

rows.d: Fades the tint of the strum arrows to a color in duration seconds. Same targets as setStrumTint. Returns the tag.
rows.note: Calls onTweenCompleted(tag) at the end. cancelTween, pauseTween and resumeTween work with the tag. A new tween or setStrumTint on the same arrows takes over.

rows.d: Puts the tint of the strum arrows back to the one of the note pack (no tint if the pack has none). With a duration it fades back. Same targets as setStrumTint.

rows.p: tag, obj, uniform, value, duration, ?{ease, type, startDelay, loopDelay, onStart, onUpdate, onComplete}
rows.d: Tweens a float of a shader (sprite, character or "camGame:name"). Stop it with cancelTween(tag), pause it with pauseTween.
rows.note: obj can also be "stage:name" for a shader added in the Stage Editor.

rows.p: tag, obj, values, duration, ?{ease, type, startDelay, loopDelay, onStart, onUpdate, onComplete}
rows.d: Tweens several shader values at once, of any type: values = {uniform = value, ...}. float and int take a number (int is rounded), vec2/vec3/vec4 take a list ({0.5, 1}) or one number for every part, vec3/vec4 also take a color ("FF3344", turned into 0-1 values). bool values change at the end of the tween. obj = an object or character with a shader, "camGame:name" for a camera shader, or "stage:name" for a shader added in the Stage Editor. options like startTween (ease, type, startDelay, loopDelay, onStart, onUpdate, onComplete). Returns the tag.
rows.note: The uniform type is read from the shader by itself. onStart, onUpdate and onComplete receive (tag, obj). cancelTween, pauseTween and resumeTween work with the tag. Wrong names or values are skipped with an error (luaDebugMode = true).

rows.d: Makes characters sing together: the children copy every sing animation of the father, misses too. father and children: bf, dad, gf, 3..10 or "character3"; children as text "3, 4" or table {3, 4}. all = true: every character on the father's side. No children and all off = the father sings alone again. Same as the Character Sing-Along event. Returns false if the father isn't a valid name.
Table of who is singing along with the father ("bf", "dad", "gf", "3"...). Empty = nobody.

Table of the chart's extra characters. Each one has: slot (3..10), name ("character3", use it in getProperty, playAnim...), character (loaded character, empty = the side sings), parent (bf, dad or gf), strumline ("shared" or "separate"), playable (true = the player plays its notes), visible (has a visible strumline of its own).
